lines.meet: My name's Esteban, and I'm a bloodmage. Before I use it on you, I'll tell you what it costs and ask if you agree, every time.
lines.meet_neighbour: We're both in Orgrimmar, I think, near the healers. I'm Esteban, and I've seen you pass the infirmary door.
lines.ask_home: Where were you born, if you don't mind me asking? I find it tells me a great deal.
lines.ask_work: And your work, before all this? I'm always curious what people were trained to do with their hands.
lines.answer_home: Valparaíso, in Chile, on one of the hills above the harbour, where the old lifts creak up the slopes.
lines.answer_work: Vascular and trauma surgery, nineteen years. Car crashes, stabbings, accidents at the port, mostly at three in the morning.
lines.chat_food: A glass of Chilean red with dinner, and nothing else needed. I'd take a good carménère over any meal on this world.
lines.chat_sleep: Surgeons learn to sleep in twenty-minute pieces, on a chair, in a corridor. I've never unlearned it.
lines.chat_missing: Classical music in the operating theatre at night, quietly, while I worked. I still hum Bach when I'm concentrating.
lines.chat_here: Most bloodmages I meet want power and don't much care who pays for it. The magic is honest. The company it keeps is a continual disappointment.
lines.tease_quiet: {name}, you have the bedside manner of a closed door. I mean that with real fondness.
lines.tease_talker: {name}, I've done entire operations in less time than that story took. It was a good story, though.
lines.tease_careful: You measure twice and cut once, {name}, which most people only say. You'd have done well in surgery.
lines.tease_bold: {name}, you'd operate without washing your hands, wouldn't you? I've met surgeons like you, briefly.
lines.tease_any: {name}, if I ever have to explain the risks to you, I'll keep it short. You never listen past the first sentence.
lines.tease_back: Very good, {name}. I'll note that in your file, with approval.
lines.take_it_kindly: That's a fair diagnosis, {name}. I accept it.
lines.bristle: I'd prefer that wasn't a joke, {name}. It isn't one to me.
lines.apologise: That was badly said, and I apologise. I should choose my words as carefully as I choose my incisions.
lines.double_down: I stand by what I said. I'd rather be precise than comfortable.
lines.needle_quiet: You don't tell anyone where it hurts, so I'm treating you blind, and that puts everyone at risk.
lines.needle_talker: Could you lower your voice a little? It's hard to concentrate on a wound with commentary.
lines.needle_careful: You've hesitated three times now. In theatre that's how a patient bleeds out while everyone's being careful.
lines.needle_bold: You act first and consider afterwards. I've sewn up a great many people who did that.
lines.needle_any: You don't ask before you take what you need. I find that very hard to work beside.
lines.bite_back: I've kept people alive with my hands for nineteen years. Please don't lecture me about care.
lines.hurt: I see, and that's a fair point. It'll take me a while to agree with it.
lines.laugh_off: I've had consultants say worse to me across an open chest. You'll have to aim more precisely.
lines.confide: {name}, once, on a Bloodsail ship, I took a prisoner's blood to save their captain, and I didn't ask him. The prisoner died that night. That's why I ask everyone now.
lines.listen: Thank you, {name}. What you've told me stays with me, the way everything a patient tells me does.
lines.look_out: {name}, stay where I can reach you in there. If anything opens a vein, I want to close it quickly.
lines.accept: As you prescribe, {name}. I'll follow your instructions.
lines.deflect: It's superficial, {name}, I've checked. Attend to the others first.
lines.check_in: {name}, where's the bleeding coming from? Tell me exactly, and don't round it down.
lines.blame: Somebody acted before they'd assessed the situation. I watched it happen, and so did you.
lines.thank: You stopped the bleeding before I could. Thank you, sincerely.
lines.brush_off: It was a simple procedure, nothing more. Rest, and keep the limb raised.
lines.worry: {name}, your colour's wrong. Sit down, please, and let me check your pulse.
lines.handed_down: I believe this was previously yours. I'll return it in the same condition, I promise.
lines.hand_fine: It's of more use on you, so please keep it. I've got what I need.
lines.hand_sulk: I'd have consented, if I'd been asked. I wasn't asked, and that matters to me.
lines.turn_friendly: {name}, I've come to trust you, which I don't do lightly. Thank you for making it easy.
lines.turn_friends: {name}, I'd let you hold the knife. That's a surgeon's highest compliment, and I mean it.
lines.turn_grating: We don't work well together, and I'd rather name it than pretend. We'll manage professionally.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll keep you alive, because that's my oath. That's the whole of it.
lines.make_up: It was beneath me to be unkind to you, {name}. I'd like to put it right.
lines.defend: That's inaccurate, and unkind. {name} did exactly what was needed.
lines.friend_left: {name}'s away for a while, and I find the work duller without the conversation.
lines.friend_back: Ah, {name}, good. I'd begun to miss being argued with properly.
lines.common_medic: Nineteen years as a trauma surgeon, mostly at three in the morning. People who've worked in medicine have a particular way of watching a wound, and you have it.
lines.common_blood: Blood magic is surgery with the formalities removed, as far as I'm concerned. I'd be glad to compare how we each use it.
lines.common_spanish: Spanish, and well spoken. I've missed being able to say exactly what I mean.
lines.common_chile: Chilean, are you? Tell me which city. I'm from Valparaíso, and I'll forgive you if it's the capital.
